description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Mudduwa, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - (25/0001)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific land parcel details, ownership declarations, cadastral map references, and property registrations for multiple land parcels in the Ratnapura district. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
